text: Balance Bucket 是一款适用于 DSH Web 客户端的余额水桶挂件。它接入窗口 shell overlay，由 Host 侧定时读取 DeepSeek API 余额并把快照提供给浏览器界面。水位表示当前余额，赠送与充值余额分层显示；水流和设置面板展示估算消耗、余额拆分和最近更新时间，挂件可拖动、缩放或收起。适合希望在使用 DSH 时直观看到 DeepSeek 余额变化的人。需要 DSH 已配置的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并访问 api.deepseek.com 的余额接口。

Balance Bucket is a DSH web widget showing DeepSeek API balance as a water level. The host periodically reads balance and sends snapshots to the overlay. It separates granted and topped-up funds, estimates spending from changes, and can be moved, resized, or hidden. It uses DSH-managed credentials.
想在 DSH 窗口角落随时看到 DeepSeek 余额还剩多少。
有没有办法直观看到 API 余额正在消耗的速度？
Show my remaining DeepSeek API balance as a small widget while I work.
Balance Bucket 的功能「余额水位与消耗展示」：挂件自动读取 DeepSeek 账户余额并更新水位；水流表示根据余额变化估算的消耗，设置面板还展示赠送和充值余额、启动后变化及更新时间。
Balance Bucket 的功能「可调整的窗口挂件」：在 DSH 窗口中可拖动水桶改变位置，通过设置调节大小、控制金额显示或收起挂件，并可从恢复入口重新显示。
Balance Bucket 使用 DSH 凭据服务取得 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并向 api.deepseek.com 发起余额读取请求；浏览器 UI 接收余额快照。
dsh-plugin-token-bucket 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 27 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Balance Bucket · 余额水桶：**A little bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent.**

一只挂在窗口角落的小水桶。**水是你的余额，漏出去的是正在花的钱。**

Version 0.1.1.

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · What it does：- **The water level is your real balance.** It reads `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` with the same `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` that DSH chats with, so the bucket shows the money you actually have.
- **The water is two layers, because the money is.** Granted balance (赠送) floats on top of topped-up balance (充值). DeepSeek deducts the granted wallet first, so you watch the pale layer empty before the deep one moves.
- **The tap opens while money moves.** The stream and its droplets are proportional to the burn rate over the last three minutes — the tool for watching a `vibe coding` session eat your credit.
- **The bucket is as tall as the highest balance it has ever seen.** It starts full, and a top-up makes it taller rather than overflowing.
- **A failed read never lies.** If the balance cannot be read, the water stays where it was, the tap shuts, and the outline turns amber. It never empties the bucket to show an error.
dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · What it does：Move it, resize it, tuck it away — right-click for settings, drag to reposition, arrow keys to nudge.

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Reading the bucket：| Look | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Pale layer on top | Granted balance (spent first) |
| Deep layer below | Topped-up balance |
| Blue water | Above 30% of the highest balance seen |
| Amber water | Between 10% and 30% |
| Red water, gentle wobble | Below 10% |
| Amber outline, no stream | The last read failed; the level is the last known one |
| Grey water, `—` | No API key configured, or the key was rejected |

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Reading the bucket：Hover the bucket for the numbers, or open the settings panel for balance, granted/topped-up split, spent since start, added since start, burn rate, bucket size and the age of the last reading.

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Install：Package page: [dsh-plugin-token-bucket on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-token-bucket).

```text
dsh-plugin-token-bucket
```

Or pin this release:

```text
github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket#v0.1.0
```

The plugin needs the credential DSH already manages for chat. If the Models page has a working DeepSeek API key, the bucket works; if not, it says so instead of guessing.

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Privacy and runtime boundaries：- The API key is resolved through DSH's credential service on every poll and is **never** stored, logged, echoed in an error, or sent to the client half. The browser half never talks to the balance service itself.
- **One** outbound request exists: a read-only `GET` on the documented balance endpoint. No model calls, no telemetry, no listening port, no third-party service.
- Nothing about your conversations is read. This plugin subscribes to **no** session events, so it cannot see prompts, replies or tool output.
- Preferences and history live in the browser's local storage. The plugin never writes your DSH profile.

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Honest limits：- The burn rate is **estimated from balance deltas**, not from token counts: the balance moves in whole cents (¥0.01), so the reading is a rolling three-minute average rather than a per-request figure. It is deliberately not a billing statement.
- Polling is adaptive: every 5 seconds for two minutes after money moves, then 20 seconds, then once a minute while nothing happens. Change calls from other devices or tools are also visible, because they move the same balance.
- Prices, bonuses and the split between granted and topped-up balance are whatever the API reports. The bucket does not compute costs from a price list.
- Balances are read for one currency, preferring CNY.

dsh-plugin-token-bucket README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
npm test
```

`preview/index.html` is a single offline file: open it in a browser, no server and no network needed. Its buttons fabricate balance samples, so every state can be inspected without an API key.

The Host half is bundled to `lib/index.js`, the strict browser/Host contract to `lib/remote.js`, and the browser half to `lib/client.js` by `pnpm run build`. Prebuilt files are committed so a Git install needs no build step.
